changes: Archived v1 Task Authorization and Worker Result schemas and introduced hardened v2 contracts for future tasks.
Added exact base-policy binding and a base-anchored trust ceiling that rejects scope/action self-widening.
Added a pull_request_target trusted gate that executes verifier code from the PR base and handles PR-head task/result files only as data.
Added external GitHub Actions evidence verification binding run ID, workflow name, repository, implementation SHA, success and ancestry.
Added append-only hash-chained recovery events with monotonic anti-loop counters.
Added central policy profiles for PINK IPTV, FADEGO and VCAM-PRO based on live workflow evidence.
Made plugin packaging byte-reproducible and added SHA256SUMS plus a machine-readable supply-chain manifest.
Bumped Project Leader to 0.4.0 and Recovery Guardian to 0.3.0.

residual_blockers: PR #5 and stacked PR #6 remain unmerged and require explicit Owner merge authorization before main can inherit these controls.
